name: Bodyweight good morning
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, hands behind your head.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as your chest lowers forward.
Keep a soft bend in the knees and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
cue: Hinge back, flat back, drive hips forward
mistakes: Bending the knees too much and squatting instead.
